title: Ridge Creek Gateway 4 Friends, Families &Corporate
description:
Escape to this stunning 1-acre hilly retreat with  creek in the front, woods in the back, and a lush lawn filled with fruit trees and flowering shrubs. Fenced backyard with chicken & sheep. Perfect for weddings, receptions, reunions, and corporate meetings with parking for 30+ cars. Sleeps 14 guests, featuring 3 living rooms, 5 bed rooms, a game room/meeting space for 50, and a fully equipped kitchen with an 8-seat dining area. Ideal for nature lovers and group gatherings. Book your stay today

The space
🏡 Bedroom & Bathroom Layout (Easy Overview)

The home has 5 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, laid out across two levels.

Main Floor (No Stairs)
• Almond Suite
– 1 bedroom
– Private attached full bathroom
– Sleeps 2
Upper Floor (Accessed by Stairs)
• Pear Suite
– 1 bedroom
– Private attached full bathroom
– Sleeps 2
• Walnut Suite
– 1 bedroom
– Private attached full bathroom
– Sleeps 4
• Maple Suite (2 Bedrooms)
– Consists of two separate bedrooms (sometimes listed as Maple Suite and Maple Suite 2)
– These two bedrooms are connected by a shared Jack-and-Jill full bathroom
– Combined sleeping capacity: up to 6 guests

Important Notes

• Almond, Pear, and Walnut Suites each have their own private bathrooms
• Maple Suite rooms are separate bedrooms but share one bathroom
• Photos may look similar for Maple Suite rooms because they are part of the same connected suite

Other things to note
ROOM LAYOUT: Main floor Almond Suite (private bath, sleeps 2). Upstairs: Pear Suite (private bath, sleeps 2), Walnut Suite (private bath, sleeps 4), Maple Suite = 2 bedrooms sharing a Jack & Jill bath (sleeps 6).
Best room assignments for groups: Babies or light sleepers do well in Almond or Pear Suites (private baths). Snorers are best in Almond, Pear, or Walnut Suites. Maple Suite is ideal for families sharing space.
